Algorithm attribution: Edge Tangent Flow from Kang et al., Coherent Line Drawing,
NPAR 2007. The upstream implementation labels the ETF equations (1)-(5).

This adaptation:
  - Uses CPU TypedArrays and no DOM/GPU/model/network dependency.
  - Keeps image x/y coordinates and clamped Sobel borders from the WebGL port.
  - Uses separable 5x5 Sobel and exact area downsampling before refinement.
  - Follows the strict circular spatial window, magnitude weighting,
    direction weighting and sign alignment of upstream ETF equations (1)-(5).
  - Replaces phi*abs(dot) with the mathematically identical dot product.
  - Interpolates a tanh weight table at 1/1024 spacing; tested against a direct
    Math.tanh implementation of the upstream equations (max vector error <2e-6).
  - Adds absolute-gradient confidence, physical-aspect-aware doubled-angle grid
    pooling, progress/cancellation hooks, finite-input validation and timing.
  - Does not include upstream FDoG/thresholding, demo UI, or any image samples.
  - Does not identify people or produce a subject segmentation mask.
